reconstructed_values.neutral_material_policy: matte slate and graphite body volumes, dark neutral rubber, neutral steel, restrained amber visibility cues, clear neutral glazing, no manufacturer colors, logos, wordmarks, decals, or copied textures
reconstructed_values.geometry_boundary: Only the cited carrier envelope, selected header span, running-gear designation, nominal track width, capacities, and named equipment are manufacturer-bound. Body surfacing, header depth, undercarriage proportions, tyre shape, hidden structure, pivots, anchors, clearances, and detail placement are independently authored visualization choices.

unresolved_choices: exact production serial, order code, country-road equipment, and dealer-installed options
exact TrakRide belt, pad, guide-block, drive-wheel, roller, tensioner, and carrier-frame geometry
exact 520/85R30 loaded radius, tread, rim, pressure, offset, and steering geometry
overall length with the selected PowerFlow 10.70 m attachment
PowerFlow header depth, reel, tine, belt, intake-auger, crop-divider, and coupling geometry
all body panels, cab structure, grain-tank surfacing, service doors, lights, mirrors, rails, and vents
all manufacturer colors, graphics, badges, decals, wordmarks, and trade dress
mechanical_gaps: Track motion is a rigid presentation abstraction without physical lug engagement, tension, deformation, slip, soil contact, or differential-drive dynamics.
Header lift and lateral compensation use reconstructed pivots and do not model cylinder pressure, load, TerraControl response, field surface, or stability.
Reel, PowerFlow, intake, Dual Helix, RotorFeeder, ShortCut, chaff and SwingFlow motion omit crop particles, torque, speed control, clearances, guards, and internal driveline authority.
The 8.4 m unloader swing, fold and spout-flap choreography uses reconstructed hinges, angles and timing and is not an operating or clearance instruction.
Cooling-fan reversal and ladder motion are presentation cues without control logic, interlocks, service-state authority, or validated collision envelopes.
